security_audit.summary: The script performs real external network calls to BrowserAct and handles a BrowserAct API key. Most markdown backtick, documentation URL, and system-reconnaissance alerts are false positives. One semantic issue remains because the skill tells users they can provide an API key directly to the agent.

remediation.suggestion: Tell users to set BROWSERACT_API_KEY in their local environment or a secret manager. Do not ask users to paste API keys into chat.
Disclose that keywords, limits, marketplace URLs, and task identifiers are sent to BrowserAct before running the workflow.

remediation.issue: Shell command guidance with user-provided values
remediation.suggestion: Validate limit and marketplace_url values before execution. Prefer argument-array execution instead of constructing shell strings.
Restrict marketplace_url to expected Amazon marketplace hosts before sending it to the BrowserAct workflow.

content.value_statement: Amazon product research often needs current prices, ratings, and sales signals from many listings. This skill uses BrowserAct to collect structured Amazon marketplace data.
actual_capabilities: Runs a Python script that calls the BrowserAct workflow API.
Accepts search keywords, result limits, and Amazon marketplace URLs.
Starts a BrowserAct workflow template for Amazon product discovery.
Polls task status and prints timestamped progress updates.
Documents expected fields such as price, rating, reviews, ASIN, and product URL.
limitations: Requires a BrowserAct API key and outbound internet access.
Sends search terms and marketplace URLs to BrowserAct.
Does not validate marketplace URLs or result limits before sending requests.
The current script may not print completed task results because of its polling control flow.

use_cases.title: Research product demand
use_cases.description: Collect Amazon listing signals for a keyword to compare prices, ratings, reviews, and sales indicators.

use_cases.title: Monitor competitor listings
use_cases.description: Review product prices, promotions, availability, and badges across relevant Amazon search terms.

use_cases.title: Compare regional marketplaces
use_cases.description: Run the same search against different Amazon marketplace URLs to inspect availability and price differences.

prompt_templates.title: Find a small product set
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to search Amazon best sellers for wireless earbuds. Limit results to 10 and use https://www.amazon.com.

prompt_templates.title: Check a competitor category
prompt_templates.prompt: Find best-selling gaming mice on Amazon. Return price, rating, review count, availability, promotion, ASIN, and product links.

prompt_templates.title: Compare regions
prompt_templates.prompt: Search running shoes on amazon.com and amazon.co.uk. Compare prices, availability, ratings, and product badges.

prompt_templates.title: Build a market snapshot
prompt_templates.prompt: Research portable projectors across Amazon marketplaces. Summarize pricing bands, review strength, promotional patterns, and notable product gaps.

output_examples.input: Find 10 best-selling gaming mice on amazon.com.
output_examples.output: A ranked product summary with titles, brands, current prices, ratings, review counts, availability, badges, and product links.

output_examples.input: Compare wireless earbuds on amazon.com and amazon.de.
output_examples.output: A regional comparison that highlights price differences, availability changes, review strength, and marketplace-specific promotions.

output_examples.input: Research desk lamps for a product launch brief.
output_examples.output: A market snapshot with common price ranges, highly rated examples, sales indicators, and notable positioning patterns.

best_practices: Set BROWSERACT_API_KEY in the local environment instead of pasting it into chat.
Start with specific keywords and a small result limit before expanding research.
Verify marketplace URLs and follow applicable platform and data use rules.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys, tokens, or account secrets into prompts.
Do not use very broad keywords with high limits for a first run.
Do not treat marketplace data as final without checking freshness and source context.

faq.question: What data can this skill collect?
faq.answer: It can collect product titles, brands, prices, ratings, review counts, availability, promotions, ASINs, categories, badges, and product links.

faq.question: Does it require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires BROWSERACT_API_KEY to be set in the local environment before running.

faq.question: Can it compare different Amazon regions?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide different Amazon marketplace URLs, such as the United States, United Kingdom, or Germany marketplaces.

faq.question: Does it browse Amazon directly from my machine?
faq.answer: No. The script sends workflow requests to BrowserAct, which runs the configured product discovery workflow.

faq.question: Is the output always complete?
faq.answer: No. Results depend on BrowserAct task completion, Amazon availability, network conditions, and the current script control flow.

faq.question: How should I protect credentials?
faq.answer: Store the BrowserAct key as an environment variable or secret. Do not share it in prompts or transcripts.
